_readme: External images and sounds the client uses instead of the code drawing (public/assetlib.js). Empty = everything code-drawn. Written by scripts/import-art.mjs --install (approved files from the repo's asset/ folder; sources recorded in asset/CREDITS.md). Keys: weapon.<kind>.t<tier> | .lg.<power> | .set.<set> | .skin.<motif>, icon.weapon.<kind>..., icon.item.<item id>; free-form for others (mob.twinhare, sfx.coin). Paths are relative to public/.
